concerns.text: The coverage table and task bodies cite FR-001 through FR-007, but spec.md contains NO enumerated FR-001…FR-NNN requirements — only prose Objectives 1–5 and a passing mention of 'FR-007' in Key Assumptions. These are stale/unanchored tags: an implementer cannot trace them to a spec requirement. Either enumerate the FRs in spec.md or re-anchor the table rows to the spec's Objectives/Validation Criteria.

data-model.md claims alignment with 'FR-001 to FR-010', but no task covers or even references FR-008–FR-010; their content is unknown, so coverage of three referenced requirements cannot be verified. Add tasks or note their disposition.

T005 sweeps N ∈ {100,500,1000,2000} × seeds {42,123,456,789} 'consuming checksummed raw matrices', but the only raw matrix any task references is data/raw/matrix_N1000_seed42.npy (T003). No task generates or checksums the other 15 N/seed combinations — a coverage gap that makes T005 unexecutable as written.

Principle VII requires verifying that the spectral norm θ of P_N is preserved exactly, but T002's unit tests cover only 'rank/sparsity preservation and mask generation' — no task or test covers spectral-norm preservation. Add an explicit spectral-norm-preservation test to T002.

T010 consumes 'data/configs/density_grid.json' with a 'fixed θ grid spanning the transition region', but no task defines or creates this grid file or its θ values — the US3 input artifact has no producing task, so its coverage is unverifiable.
